# Results (generated by attrition_model.py)

- Employees: 1,470. Overall attrition: 16.1%.
- Logistic regression: cross-validated ROC AUC 0.820
- Gradient boosting: cross-validated ROC AUC 0.814
- Model used for the risk list: Logistic regression.
- Flagging the top 20% risk scores catches 60% of actual leavers; 49% of flagged employees actually left (base rate 16%).
- Overtime what-if (descriptive): about 84 fewer leavers out of 237 if overtime staff left at the non-overtime rate.
